notes.title: next update and news
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,

some news:
- I have removed from Steam most DLC with no content for those who wished to support me:
Emperor Tier 4.99$
King Tier 3.99$
Liege Tier 2.99$
Knight Tier 1.99$
I have kept the Squire tier 0.99$ (it is more symbolic than anything now).
I think it was a mistake to ask people for money for a free game.
I am grateful and thank all people who bought the DLC (some even bought all the tier(!)) and the game when it wasn't free, it means a lot for me. I got a real job so I won't try to make more money with Clarent Saga Tactics. But I would be happy if you give a try to the other games of Clarent Saga (Prologue and Chronicles)! 

With SRPG Studio 10th anniversary, there are more sprites! I will update the game one last time with these, and also update SRPG Studio. Maybe I will add more plugins and quality of life feature if I can implement them. I also want to rewrite and improve the original script as I think my writing wasn't really good, but maybe I'll leave it as it is. I will at least give it a try!

As I have a job, I think it's a really good time to stop making games after this last update.
10 years of SRPG Studio, how time flies! (I think I started Clarent Saga Tactics back in 2016, when it was still named Crimson Sword Saga)

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.[/p]

notes.title: About the future of Clarent Saga
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here are some news regarding Clarent Saga.

Clarent Saga Tactics II is only an idea project
but I guess it will remain as such. I am running out of ideas,
energy and ressources. I will keep improving/updating the 
first one instead (if I can).

Concerning Clarent Saga: Chronicles,
I wish there is more sale (I sold around a hundred copies)
but it is alright.
I will still participate in the maximum number of 
steam sales, the greatest discount was -40% and I will
accelerate the rythm of discount.
The maximum amount of discount will be -70%.

In truth, I don't know if game creator is appropriate
as my role for this game, game conceptor may be more accurate.
Graphics, musics, battle system, script novel were (not done by me and)
only put together by me, and I did only supervise and ensure
the best game I could deliver.

When the game will reach -50% discount, I will make
a clarent saga bundle with the emperor tier dlc
of Clarent Saga Tactics (4.99$) and Clarent Saga Chronicles (9.99$)
at -50%. I will add more games to the bundle. See below.

The big news: I am announcing the next game in the Clarent Saga!
Clarent Saga: 8-bit RPG! I hired someone more skilled than me
with RPG Maker MV, I made the game concept and I will supervise it.
The game should be completed at the end of this month but
I will still need to check everything and playtest.

Finally I have an idea/concept for an action-RPG but game development will
start only after this one is released!

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: Clarent Saga Tactics II Idea Project
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

after some thought I am thinking of making a follow-up game.
A SRPG Studio user knwown as Von Ithipathachai has made a sample project,
and I want to use it as a base for this sequel.
It will be made with the same software (SRPG Studio),
the first one was made with Fire Emblem 4 in mind,
I want to make it a side game like Fire Emblem 5.
The idea is to make a more complex and harder game
with varied objectives. Some changes idea include:
change battle formula, skills,
breakable weapons,
add a weapon rank and support system.
Lots of asset will be reused but the maps will be new.
It will be a paid game but I don't know if I will do an early access
or make a complete version before releasing it.
Please note that I will work on Clarent Saga : Chronicles and complete it first.

Thanlk you for your support!
David Nguyen.

notes.title: Some news...
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here are some news concerning the future of Clarent Saga Tactics. The fire emblem fanfic writer (Jessie Paluta also know as May ravenstaff online) has nearly finished the arranged script. The next update (v1.19) will cover chapter 25 to 30. I am working on it right now.

The last chunck will cover chapter 31 to 36 and will be in the next update (v1.20). Next update (v1.21) will be playtesting the game to death. I like the idea of v 1.21 to be the last. I think there is (always) room for improvement but to be honest I am tired of this project. The software (SRPGStudio) has come to maturity I think. There will always be new plugins, materials and other stuffs but I think I've done enough. 

To have closure for this game will be great so I can concentrate on my other project (Clarent Saga Chronicles). I also felt that Clarent Saga Tactics should be a paid game but I can't go back so it will remain free. I think I will retire from game making after Clarent Saga Chronicles. I am a little sad but glad to have make these games, as long as people have fun with them, this make me happy. 

Thank you for your support!
David Nguyen.

notes.title: v1.02 released and some comments
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a minor update and some comments. The changes:

- Damage preview plugin from MarkyJoe added,
The battle forecast will preview how much damage each unit may take.
- changed old magic effects to new ones from the magic effects DLC,
- Changed some icon tomes (all are differents now).

Comments: I am fully satisfied with my game (in every aspect). Some people may find some "faults" and "shortcomings" in my game. But I think I have achieved the "purest" strategy game I can deliver. For example the minimal story and script is a deliberate choice (because I acknowledge I am not a good writer and storyteller) to keep it straightforward. Every game design choice I have made is to suit my own taste in gaming (and I have played nearly a thousand games) but I have still tried my best to make it accessible to the largest number of people. Of course, I could add more complexity in my game (enemies reinforcement, fog of war, weather, weapon experience level, reaver weapons, breakable weapons, more skills, more weapon type, stealing, etc.) but either I don't like these features or I simply don't find these fun. I think the result is a fun game that people can enjoy, but as an avid gamer I also acknowledge that it will never reach the height of a masterpiece.

Thank you for your support!
David Nguyen.

notes.title: Release of the DLCs
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The DLC replicate a "pay-what-you-liked" model as different tiers of purchase: if you decide to support the game, you can buy any single DLC tier (or multiple ones) to choose the amount you want to pay.

I must insist: the game is and will remain free! You can now decide if this game is worth your time or money (and in this case which amount). I would already be really happy if you give the game a try or play it! The game script in pdf format has also been released as a free DLC!

I may stream my game on Twitch but this won't be right now.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: v1.00 released and other news - the end?
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am happy to say the final version v1.00 is released. Since the last update, there are minor corrections so this isn't really a big new. The other news are more interesting:

- I officially retire from gamemaking. I will still work on Clarent Saga if I ever feel the need and still be active on this forum. I may even stream me playing my game on Twitch someday!
- The game is and will remain free but I will add DLC with no content if you want to support me financially . Even without paying, I would be already happy if you give this game a try.
- The game script in PDF format will be released as a free DLC.
- Finally the data on the game guide has been updated with the new version.

It was a very long journey and I am a little sad to see the end of this project. I don't plan on making more game, still I sincerely hope that people will enjoy and like this game.

Thank you for your support,
David N.

By no mean it is a perfect game but I find it quite enjoyable and fun. I also want to release some paid DLC :

notes.title: beta v28 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a regular update. Here are the changes:
- all tutorial screenshots updated.
- changed Challenge mode : renamed Very Hard instead. This difficulty has been changed from «unfair» to «fair»: it relies a lot less on RNG and luck, enemies group move when a certain number of turns has passed. Note that it is not that hard anyway, this is a deliberate choice because I don’t want a frustrating experience but a fun one. Still far from a cakewalk and a less tedious difficulty than it once was overall. 
- Add remove level cap in cheats option : characters in part 1 and 2 has their maximum level cap raised to 21 (instead of 7 in part 1 and 14 in part 2) when activating this cheat.   
- LV Max in cheats option change: characters now don’t automatically promote when activating this cheat. 
- Ch1 change: the tile behind the throne is now traversable. This greatly change the strategy on very hard mode.
- Ch2 change: Swaped north traversable tile between the Ballistician and the bow knight (like I intended to)
- Ch11 change : archer allies have Red Bow instead of a Double Bow.
(Mt 10 and 2 consecutives attack when initiating battle) 
- Sarah start as a priest of Light (better stats cap). Sage class bonus stats corrected.

I have playtested thoroughly on the hardest difficulty. I am always seeking way to improve my game. 

Thank you for your support,
David N.

notes.title: Some news...
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to price the game again (for various reason) but Valve didn't approve my wish. Here is their answer:
"It's not great practice or fair for users to keep swapping an app's pay model at will like this.
If you've made some big updates or changes, I would suggest selling this as an upgrade DLC."  

Thinking about it, they are totally right. I also planned a Kickstarter to add custom music and graphics as DLC but cancelled it right away because I miscalculated the estimated cost. So the game will remain free!

I have given up on hiring Moonwind but I will still update the game once in a while with Sir Wolfram's reworked script and new plugins. I can finally move on another project. I really enjoyed my time on this project!

Thank you for your support!
David N.

Some news
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you are all well, in my case I am in good health. Here are some news. I have given up the arena fights because they were too difficult to implement, there is a script available but not the way I want it to work. The generation system where you choose your bride has also been abandoned due to constraints and in the end this doesn't add much to the game.

I was also considering adding exploration like a traditional RPG, there is also a script available who work nicely but I gave up on this idea. There are already the two excellent Shining Force games on steam at a ridiculously low price...

A minor thing is the critical animations have been slightly reworked. It felt a little silly that the attackers did the hit animation thrice sometimes, it has been reduced to two (which fit nicely with the double damage output).

The big change coming is the reworked script/story with a writer working on it (Sir Wolfram), he is clearly a better writer than me. It will then be proofread and carefully checked. Depending on my motivation, a french version may also come out later. Finally, once I reach 5000 sales, Steam cards will be added.

Thank you for your support,
David N.

notes.title: Some ideas for the next update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here are some ideas for a future update.
1) add arena fights at the beginning of each map instead of some bonus exp. I don't know if I can implement it properly though.
2) More choice for the generation part (see below).

[spoiler]In part 1 Siegfried could choose his bride between Abigail, Nanna, and Brynhildr.
That will reflect Awan stat, growth rate and ability. Depending on her mother Awan can wield axe, spear or bow as a sub weapon and get one legendary weapon (Mjolnir, Trishula or Artemis Bow). 

In part 2 Abel could choose his bride between Ami, Athena, and Anne.
That will reflect Cain stat, growth rate and ability. Basically if Cain's mother is:
-Ami, Cain get a drain sword and medium sword as starting weapons
-Athena, Cain get a wind sword and double sword as a starting weapons
-Anne, Cain only starts with a medium sword but he can use all wands
(such as Distant heal and Full heal)

To realize this, I need to change Awan and Cain hair and eyes color and rewrite some dialog to match this!
[/spoiler]

By the way, the script/scenario rewriting may take a while, but I am not in a hurry. A minimal script has it charm too...

Thank you for your support!
David N.

ps: too many awesome games are coming this month! So my game will be a low priority...

6) So far I have around 2500 sales, with 2500 more I may finally be able to add steam cards.

notes.title: Plan for the release v1.00!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

here is some plan for the game.

I will add an "imperial" paths which consist of 3 maps.
At scenario 16, if you lose (just let Abel die) you will go to scenario 17B, 18B and 19B and switch back to David's team. I always wanted to do a full branching storyline like in my first game The Peloran Wars but because of the story it wouldn't feel quite right for Abel to switch side like joining the Empire...
You get a new character named Ishtar (Issal's sister) who joins to stop her brother and the best healer of the game! "new" enemies will appear as well like Minerva (Athena's big sister) and other!

Most of the maps are used 2 times in differents context so It won't get too repetitive. There will be a bonus challenge map once you finish the game where you will battle against all special characters (around 36) of the game who will rush you! It is not supposed to be cleared (maybe someone will succeed!) and the goal is simply to defeat as many enemies as possible!

Finally the crimson sword will be named Clarent (as Excalibur counterpart).
I will keep the title as it is and the unofficial name of the game will be Clarent Saga: Tactics.

Everything is carefully planned in my head but I am a little burned out of this project. I really love the game and all but I am tired of testing it again and again. So I will take the time to complete v1.00! Of course Srpg Studio will be updated with the latest version!

I sincerely hope people will find enjoyment with this game.
Best regards,
David Nguyen.
